entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The Shape view uses the shared normal grid because the source release provides no registered surface imagery. The grid is a coordinate guide, not regolith, measured albedo or an optical photograph.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: NEOWISE thermal diameter 130.099 ± 0.554 km
entries.finding: [NEOWISE thermal diameter 130.099 ± 0.554 km](https://ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/sbdb.api?sstr=588&phys-par=1) — alternative — Consistent thermal effective diameter, but its formal precision omits systematic errors; occultation volume scale is more directly compatible.
entries.revisitWhen: New calibration or independent size evidence makes this alternative preferable to the currently adopted, physically compatible scale; do not average incompatible thermal fits.
